ownerSelectedScope: More familiar food words like ჩიფსი, ტოსტი and დონატი, within existing 3–6-letter rules.
method: Exact-spelling deduplication against all content JSON and all VOCABULARY review JSON/text, including approved, rejected, unselected and skipped spellings. Reviewed dictionary and official Georgian food-name sources individually; no menu-only shortened spellings were used.
limitations: The exact six selected food/drink senses are approved and await integration. Active revision 30 remains unchanged.
The other four spellings remain unapproved for required use, without an explicit all-gameplay exclusion. Do not propose any of the ten reviewed spellings again as new.
Existing barbarism, plural, grammar, length and campaign rules remain in force.
No candidate boards, repetition benefits or capacity gains have been validated.
